method.renderer: Actual FightEngine.update/render and the original native Canvas drawImage. Each stage is selected through its normal stage descriptor.
method.inputs: Only registered InputState keydown/keyup callbacks receive synthetic native events. No actor position, facing, health, phase, presentation or clock is assigned.
method.decoder: PNG encoding normalized in memory for native decoding; every decoded RGBA byte is compared before/after.
method.scope: Existing fighters exercise initial stage composition, movement in both directions, release to idle, exact planes, live parallax and cache admission.

limits: Native Canvas does not exercise Chromium, DOM/CSS, HTTP, actual browser keyboard delivery or service workers.
No new fighter pose, attack, contact, guard, finisher, stage hazard, original timing or 1:1 artistic fidelity is certified.
Two static stage planes and their runtime parallax do not constitute a new source animation.
cataloguePolicy: The whole catalogue is hashed before/after this process. Later unrelated imports may change its global hash; aggregation must still require exact tested-entry hashes and unchanged renderer/gameplay modules.
